data_fields.name: foliage density
data_fields.donor_constant: settings value clamped 0..1 (1 keeps all, 0 stops)

data_fields.name: models per chunk cap
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (one draw per model per chunk)

best_idea: One instanced draw per model per chunk, with chunk-local transforms, a chunk-level distance cull and deterministic density thinning, keeps foliage inside a phone frame budget.
decision_why: Foliage is client-only and the chunk shape fits zones-as-data and phone frame pacing; take the chunk batching, chunk-local positions and chunk distance cut, fix the density accumulator (one per chunk, border filter first, stable order) and drop the per-frame near/far callback.
acceptance: On a phone-width world zone (375 wide), foliage shows out to the foliage distance setting with no pop-in in front of the player, and a dev overlay reports foliage draw calls at or below one per model per visible chunk; a unit test asserts chunkInRange is false beyond view distance and thinChunk keeps the same ids for the same plants in a different input order.
